mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (member_id, board_type, title, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.board_type, b.title, m.nickname, b.created_at FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board b
# 게시판 타입
AND b.board_type = #{boardType}
# 제목 또는 내용 검색
AND ( b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '#') )
